short_description: A push-up variation performed with one foot raised to increase core and chest demand.
how_to: Start in a push-up position with your hands under your shoulders.
Lift one foot off the floor and hold it there.
Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
Push back up to the start and repeat.
Switch legs each set.
correct: Keep your body straight from head to heel.
Keep your elbows controlled.
Keep your hips level throughout.
Breathe steadily.
mistakes: Don't let your hips drop.
Don't flare your elbows out wide.
Don't twist your hips as you lower.
Don't rush the movement.

short_description: A squat performed on the balls of the feet to work the quads, glutes and calves together.
how_to: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Rise onto your toes and hold that position.
Bend your knees and lower into a squat.
Hold briefly at the bottom, then press back up.
Stay on your toes throughout the set.
correct: Keep your knees over your toes.
Keep your chest up and tall.
Keep your core engaged.
Move at a controlled pace.
mistakes: Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't drop too fast.
Don't lean too far forward.
Don't let your heels touch down mid-rep.

short_description: A dynamic squat thrust that adds a rotational reach to engage the core and improve mobility.
how_to: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump or step your feet back to a plank position.
Jump or step your feet back in.
Stand and rotate your torso with one arm reaching up.
Alternate the twist each rep.
correct: Keep your knees over your toes on the squat.
Keep your core braced in the plank.
Move through the twist with control.
Keep your chest up as you stand.
mistakes: Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't drop too fast on the squat.
Don't rush and lose your balance.
Don't collapse your lower back in the plank.

short_description: A forward lunge with a torso rotation that works the legs, glutes and obliques.
how_to: Stand tall with your feet together.
Step forward into a lunge and lower your back knee toward the floor.
At the bottom, rotate your torso toward your front leg.
Rotate back to centre and push off to return to standing.
Alternate legs each rep.
correct: Keep your knees over your toes.
Keep your front heel down.
Keep your chest up through the twist.
Keep your core engaged.
mistakes: Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't drop too fast.
Don't rotate before your hips are stable.
Don't lean back as you twist.

short_description: A lateral jumping drill that trains single-leg power, balance and coordination.
how_to: Stand on your right foot with a slight knee bend.
Push off and leap to the left, landing on your left foot.
Swing your right leg behind as you land.
Pause briefly, then leap back to the right.
Continue alternating sides with a steady rhythm.
correct: Land softly.
Keep your knees over your toes.
Keep your chest up on landing.
Keep your core braced throughout.
mistakes: Don't land hard.
Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't rush and skip the landing control.
Don't let your trunk collapse forward.

short_description: A kneeling hip-flexor stretch that opens the front of the hip and thigh.
how_to: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward.
Shift your hips gently forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the rear hip.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee over your ankle.
Hold the position and breathe steadily.
Switch sides and repeat.
correct: Keep your torso tall.
Relax your shoulders.
Breathe slowly and steadily.
Keep your front heel down.
mistakes: Don't force the stretch.
Don't arch your lower back.
Don't let your front knee travel past your toes.
Don't hold your breath.

exercise_name: Leaning Dumbbell One Leg Calf Raise
short_description: A single-leg calf raise with a dumbbell and a wall lean to isolate the calf muscle.
how_to: Stand facing a wall and place one hand lightly against it for balance.
Hold a dumbbell in the opposite hand at your side.
Lift the foot on the same side as the dumbbell off the floor.
Press up onto the toes of the supporting leg.
Lower with control and repeat before switching sides.
correct: Keep your supporting leg straight at the top.
Move through the full range of motion.
Keep your ankle stable throughout.
Lower slowly on the way down.
mistakes: Don't bounce at the bottom.
Don't lean too heavily on the wall.
Don't let your ankle roll outward.
Don't rush the lowering phase.

short_description: A floor exercise that strengthens the glutes and hamstrings by lifting the hips from a supine position.
how_to: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Place your arms by your sides with palms down.
Press through your heels and lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower your hips with control and repeat.
correct: Keep your feet flat on the floor.
Keep your core engaged throughout.
Keep your knees in line with your feet.
Squeeze at the top of each rep.
mistakes: Don't let your knees splay outward.
Don't push through your toes instead of your heels.
Don't drop your hips quickly.
Don't over-arch your lower back at the top.

short_description: A standing rotation drill that mobilises the torso and warms up the spine.
how_to: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold your arms out or cross them over your chest.
Rotate your torso smoothly to the right.
Return to centre, then rotate to the left.
Continue alternating at a steady pace.
correct: Keep your hips facing forward.
Relax your shoulders throughout.
Move with controlled rotation.
Breathe steadily.
mistakes: Don't jerk or snap through the rotation.
Don't let your hips swing with your torso.
Don't hold your breath.
Don't rush past the end range.

short_description: A plank variation where one arm reaches forward to challenge core stability and balance.
how_to: Start in a forearm or high plank with your body in a straight line.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Slowly extend one arm straight out in front.
Hold for a moment, then return and switch arms.
Keep your hips still throughout.
correct: Keep your body in one line.
Keep your core engaged.
Keep your hips from rotating as you reach.
Move each arm slowly and with control.
mistakes: Don't let your lower back sag.
Don't lift your hips too high.
Don't twist your hips when reaching.
Don't rush the extension.
